items.title: You can now ride a Chinese EV in the US as Waymo opens Zeekr Ojai to all
items.raw_content: Waymo is now letting all riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Phoenix hail its next-generation Ojai robotaxi — a vehicle built in China by Zeekr. That makes the Ojai one of the only ways for an American to ride in a Chinese-made EV, a car they still can’t legally buy for themselves.

items.title: Chery’s AiMOGA Robotics begins IPO preparations as it targets overseas markets

The company has not announced a timetable or selected an exchange. Its leadership said a listing could provide funding for technology investment and overseas expansion. Incubated by Chery in January 2025, AiMOGA says it has delivered […]
items.title_zh: 奇瑞AiMOGA机器人启动IPO筹备，剑指海外市场
items.summary: Chery's AiMOGA Robotics has begun preparing for a standalone IPO and is in discussions over listing venues, with no timetable or exchange selected. The company's leadership said a listing could fund technology investment and overseas expansion; AiMOGA was incubated by Chery in January 2025.

items.title: US distributor of China’s most popular humanoid robots pivots after US ban
items.raw_content: FCC ban on foreign-made robots accelerated RoboStore’s US manufacturing plans.
items.title_zh: 美国禁令后，中国最受欢迎人形机器人的美国经销商转向本土制造
items.summary: The FCC's ban on foreign-made robots accelerated RoboStore's plans to manufacture in the US. RoboStore is the US distributor of China's most popular humanoid robots.

items.title: Slovakia finds Russian backdoor in traffic speed cameras
items.title_zh: 斯洛伐克在交通测速摄像头中发现俄罗斯后门
items.summary: Slovakia's national security service, the NBU, issued a security alert against the use of NERO R-ONE high-speed traffic cameras, according to the report, which says a Russian backdoor was found.

items.title_zh: 一枚火箭撞上了月球。它无害，但下一枚可能不是
items.summary: Earlier this month, a discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage crashed into the lunar surface at 8,700 kilometers per hour — not a controlled landing — and SpaceNews examines why the next uncontrolled impact might not be so harmless.

items.title: Leaker details A20 Pro chip’s new speed gains
items.title_zh: 泄密者透露 A20 Pro 芯片新的速度提升细节
items.summary: The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra will be unveiled next month with a new A20 Pro chip; this weekend a reputable leaker shared expected performance gains per supply chain sources.

items.title_zh: The Download：死去的机器人朋友与“审查工业综合体”
items.summary: Today's edition of MIT Technology Review's Download newsletter leads with the story of a child's companion robot reaching end of life, alongside a piece on the "censorship-industrial complex."

items.title: Claude can now send emails in Gmail, even without your approval
items.title_zh: Claude 现可在 Gmail 中直接发送邮件，无需逐次确认
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude can now not only interact with Gmail, but send emails on the user's behalf without asking first, per 9to5Google.

items.title: China’s Landspace recovers booster with second  orbital launch of Zhuque-3 rocket
items.title_zh: 中国蓝箭航天朱雀三号火箭第二次轨道发射并回收一级助推器
items.summary: Landspace successfully landed the first stage of its Zhuque-3 rocket Tuesday following the second orbital launch of the rocket from the Gobi Desert.

items.title: Portland airport can charge 20 rental EVs at once – from overhead

items.summary: Portland International Airport (PDX) in Oregon can now charge up to 20 rental EVs at once without sacrificing valuable floor space, thanks to a new overhead ChargePoint fast charging system.

items.summary: A regulatory authority says Roblox's child-protection changes are inadequate, finding four major failings including adults being able to send connection requests to children without parental approval.

items.summary: A study published in the journal Fuel found that coconut-oil jet fuel matched kerosene's efficiency in engine tests while cutting hydrocarbon emissions.

items.summary: A Kaspersky expert found Android malware that serves ads and builds a proxy botnet, delivered through legitimate software for DoFun automotive head units.

items.summary: The article argues that Wi-Fi 8 is the first wireless upgrade in years that does not chase raw speed, saying earlier generations improved mostly on paper while this one focuses on what home networks need.

items.title: America is arguing over the wrong AI obstacle
items.title_zh: 美国争论错了 AI 障碍
items.summary: An SCMP opinion column argues the US is arguing over the wrong AI obstacle, noting that last month's releases of Kimi K3 by Moonshot AI and Qwen3.8-Max by Alibaba (which owns SCMP) moved markets even before auditable evidence — benchmark tables, model cards, and licenses — was fully available, with global chip stocks shedding about US$3 trillion in the weeks that followed.

items.title: Nokia reportedly plans Hangzhou R&D center closure, affecting 1,600 jobs
items.title_zh: 诺基亚据报计划关闭杭州研发中心，影响约1600个岗位
items.summary: Nokia is reportedly planning to close an R&D center in Hangzhou, a move that could affect around 1,600 jobs, per an email screenshot cited in the report showing management informing employees about the planned closure. Possible changes to Nokia offices in Beijing, Chengdu, Qingdao, and Shanghai are also under discussion.

items.title: US urged to follow China’s lead in treating data as an economic asset
items.title_zh: 美国被敦促效仿中国，将数据视为经济资产
items.summary: The US-China Economic and Security Review Commission warned in a Tuesday report that the US risks ceding global leadership in setting data rules, urging Washington to develop a national data strategy that treats data as an economic asset to prevail in emerging technologies such as AI and robotics, as China deepens the commercialization of its data troves.

items.title: AI Rebuilds Consumer Markets: ByteDance Large Models Unlock New Consumption Increment
items.title_zh: AI 重塑消费市场：字节跳动大模型解锁新增量
items.summary: ByteDance is embedding large-model capabilities as infrastructure into enterprise workflows: Doubao's scheduled agents generate competitor briefings, Seedance 2.5 synthesizes physical-world training data, and Doubao 2.1 Pro handles production-grade coding. Daily token calls passed 180 trillion in June 2026, up over 10x year over year.

items.title: Be wary of defence contractors, Chinese study warns, pointing to US system

items.summary: A study from Shanghai Jiao Tong University's National Institute of Strategic Studies warns Beijing about defence contractors gaining too much influence over policy, pointing to the profit-driven expansion of the US military-industrial complex as a cautionary example.

items.title: Why Chinese film-goers are flocking to a movie they hate
items.title_zh: 中国影迷为何争相观看一部他们并不喜欢的电影
items.summary: The animated film Niu Lai (The Arrival of the Ox) earned just 3,420 yuan on its Aug 5 debut, then spiked to over 11 million yuan in accumulated box office within about two weeks, placing it in the top 10 of China's domestic animated film charts.

items.title: BYD Fang Cheng Bao opens pre-orders for Formula S models
items.title_zh: 比亚迪方程豹开启 Formula S 系列预售
items.summary: BYD's Fang Cheng Bao brand opened pre-orders for its first sedan lineup on Aug. 20, with the Formula S and Formula S GT priced from RMB230,000 to RMB280,000. The two models made their global debut at the 2026 Chengdu Auto Show on Aug. 21, in single- and dual-motor versions.

items.title: The Tiangong Robot Family Grows: 1.35-Meter Tiangong Omni Scores Full Marks on Work
items.title_zh: 天工机器人家族扩容：1.35 米天工 Omni 工作评测满分
items.summary: At the World Robot Conference, the Tiangong robot family welcomed Tiangong Omni, a lightweight humanoid 1.35 meters tall and 39 kilograms, suited to narrow-space operations, emergency rescue and home service, demonstrating a smooth crawling advance. Tiangong 3.0 guided visitors around a vehicle display with autonomous navigation.

items.summary: 文章拆解人形机器人行业的订单真相：宇树上市首日市值一度冲高至 4449 亿元、次日回落至 2700 亿元级别，上半年赛道融资超 900 亿元；宇树 2025 年人形机器人出货 5511 台、约七成流向高校与科研机构，国家电网计划采购的约 8500 台具身设备中人形仅占 500 台。作者认为，真正商业化的标志是工业客户基于利润的持续复购，而非首次订单。

items.title: nateherkai/scroll-craft
items.title_zh: nateherkai/scroll-craft：滚动叙事网站构建技能
items.summary: Scroll Craft is an agent skill for building premium, immersive, scroll-driven websites that works with Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents. It is also available as a Claude Code plugin and is written in JavaScript.

items.title: elliothux/open-compute
items.title_zh: elliothux/open-compute：单二进制自托管 Cloudflare Workers 兼容平台
items.summary: A self-hosted, Cloudflare Workers-compatible platform that packs Workers, KV, D1, R2, Durable Objects, Queues, Workflows, Cron and more into a single Rust binary.

items.title: xevrion/breakscale
items.title_zh: xevrion/breakscale：分布式系统设计模拟器
items.summary: A system-design simulator for learning distributed systems: build a system, load it until it breaks, and watch why.

items.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
items.title_zh: SPADE：自适应合成可执行环境中的自我对弈强化学习
items.summary: OpenAI researchers introduce SPADE, a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an Environment Designer that writes executable training environments and a Reasoning Agent that learns to act in them. Scaling to 30B parameters, SPADE improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks, and lifts tool-use by +5.7 on BFCL-v4 multi-turn and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent.

items.title: Physical-Support Confidence Sets for Highly Coherent Dictionaries
items.title_zh: 高相干字典的物理支撑置信集
items.summary: The paper develops resolution-aware physical-support inference for sparse pursuit after dictionary learning, jointly accounting for uncertainty in the learned dictionary and the deployment signal representation. A cross-dictionary confidence correspondence keeps calibration-compatible dictionaries and deployment-compatible sparse representations, then projects the surviving explanations onto physical-support space.

items.title: TANGO: Treating Tokens as Operators
items.title_zh: TANGO：将 token 视为算子
items.summary: TANGO computes a nonlinear feature-wise gate at each source token, averages these gates per destination, and uses the average to modulate a linear projection of the destination, forming the diagonal core of a source-conditioned linear operator. At matched parameters and training data, full-prefix TANGO has the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood in all 16 settings, and a narrower three-set variant reaches 3.26 to 3.45 times its throughput.

items.title: Beyond Binary Priorities: Multi-Tier SLA Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
items.title_zh: 超越二元优先级：LLM 服务的多级 SLA 调度
items.summary: The authors extend Llumnix's LLM serving scheduler from a two-level priority model to an arbitrary number of tiers, evaluating the extension with the Vidur simulator under uniform, Gaussian, and enterprise priority distributions. Four priority tiers yield the best cost-effectiveness tradeoff, achieving prefill mean speedups of up to 8.3x and P99 speedups of up to 3.1x over INFaaS with cost-per-latency improvements of 46-68%.

items.title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: ADEPT：通过预训练与后训练强化学习加速灵巧操作
items.summary: ADEPT is a large-scale RL framework that pretrains a dexterous policy on a generic object-reposing task and post-trains downstream policies with that behavior as a prior. It zero-shot transfers sim-to-real to a 23-DoF Kuka-Allegro and a 29-DoF Flexiv-Sharpa, solving long-horizon tasks from challenging initial states at human-level speed.

items.title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video: From Hand-Object Interaction to Embodied AI
items.title_zh: 第一人称视频视觉语言模型综述：从手物交互到具身 AI
items.summary: A survey of vision-language models for egocentric (first-person) video understanding, tracing progress from conventional recognition architectures to multimodal foundation models and embodied systems. It identifies a consistent limitation: current models recognize visible objects more reliably than evolving interactions, actions, and user intent, especially over long activities.

items.title: RoMAN-Flow: Taming Autoregressive Normalizing Flows for Offline Reinforcement Learning in Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: RoMAN-Flow：驯服自回归归一化流用于机器人操作的离线强化学习
items.summary: RoMAN-Flow makes autoregressive normalizing-flow policies practical for offline RL in robotic manipulation via a sampling-free advantage-weighted likelihood objective and one-step distillation for low-latency deployment. It achieves competitive policy performance with substantially reduced inference latency across manipulation benchmarks and real robots.

items.title: Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation
items.title_zh: 具有稳定无穷维线性函数逼近的 Q 学习
items.summary: The paper develops a stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation framework for Q-learning from a single Markovian behavior-policy trajectory, using reconstruction and compression operators whose nonexpansiveness yields a contractive latent Bellman map with a unique fixed point. It proposes two stochastic approximation algorithms with sup-norm convergence bounds whose leading term is of order O(n^{-1/2}), controlled through covering numbers of the latent space rather than its dimension.
